label: July 6–12, 2026
intro: Toy heaven at ICONSIAM this weekend — a giant die-cast car expo, plus craft time and a city full of skating rinks.
weekday_note: The week is nearly over — everything below runs through Sunday July 12.

activities.title: Thailand Diecast Expo 2026
activities.why: Thousands of model cars and collectible toys from international die-cast brands, with interactive activities. Odds are excellent of spotting Iron Man and Avengers die-casts — for a builder kid who loves Iron Man, this is a treasure hunt.
activities.tip: Combine with the Neo Land art festival in the same building — two adventures, one trip.

activities.title: Little Bunny Craft at Bambini Villa
activities.why: Drop-in craft making sized exactly for little hands — a low-key, hands-on hour that fits around any other plan.

activities.title: BOTLC Book Fair 2026
activities.why: A calm riverside book fair with DIY activities built in. Nice slower stop — pick out a new bedtime book together.

activities.title: Neo Land Festival
activities.why: A big, colorful contemporary Thai art festival with immersive installations — walk-through art that a 5-year-old can actually enjoy.

activities.title: The World in One Bite 2026
activities.why: 150+ restaurants and 120 food pop-ups, with dessert floors and workshops. Ends Sunday — a fun grazing lunch before or after another stop.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club
activities.why: Big indoor rink with a skate academy and a dedicated play area — a proper first ice-skating lesson for Thor, with pro coaches used to little beginners.
activities.tip: Weekday sessions are cheaper and emptier. Bring socks and a jumper!

activities.title: The Rink Ice Arena, Central World
activities.why: Central location with intro lessons for kids — individual or group, per-lesson or packages. Easy to pair with lunch in the mall.

activities.title: Roller Dome
activities.why: Southeast Asia's biggest indoor roller rink — beginner-friendly with rental blades, protection gear, and artificial grass to practice standing up on.
activities.tip: The Nawamin branch is the big one; Emporium is handy for a quick first try.

activities.title: RollerLand, Gateway Ekamai
activities.why: Air-conditioned roller rink known for being clean and safe — the comfy option for rollerblade practice on a hot day.

activities.title: Rollerblading at Lumphini Park
activities.why: Rollerblading is officially allowed after 5pm, and local skate crews practice there — friendly folks who love showing kids the basics.

activities.title: Kids' Chocolate-Making Workshop at theCOMMONS
activities.why: Craft your own chocolates with a real chef using Thai chocolate. Listed for ages 6+ but close enough to ask — chocolate + making things = peak Thor.
activities.tip: Sessions run periodically — check the events page and book ahead.

activities.title: Clay Circle Pottery Studio
activities.why: Hands-in-the-mud pottery sessions that welcome kids — squishing, shaping, and taking home something you made. Exactly his kind of messy.
